lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to check whether a list contains something and use it to make decisions, like a password checker or an inventory.
The block “list contains thing?” is true if the thing is anywhere in the list.
It works in if blocks just like other conditions.
Many games keep an inventory: a list of things the player has collected.
Add an item when collected; check the list to open a door.
Store allowed passwords in a list.
Ask for the password and check if the list contains the answer.
Use “not” to check the opposite: if not (bag contains key) → say “You need a key!”.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
